finding: Reconciliation could overwrite confirmed SAVED with a conflicting FAILED response, including when concurrent reconciliation had completed while the response was pending. Conflicting UNFINISHED could also be reported after SAVED.
fix: Re-read local state after status response, reject contradictions with confirmed terminal state, and use atomic terminal updates that reject an opposing terminal outcome.
assertions: Concurrent successful confirmation is not overwritten by delayed failure
Subsequent consistent status succeeds without repeat execute
Existing in-memory CRF and audit unchanged
limitations: Contradictory responses injected in local fixture transport, not observed on the real server
Local SQLite is a regression store, not an approved Streamlit durable store
Old-key rejection, approved live recovery, sixty-minute evidence and formal QA remain incomplete
Live 165 rows and audit were not remeasured
